1879060758.name: Power of Knowledge
1879060758.desc: Lightning wreaths your enemy while restoring your own power.

1879064342.name: Burgle
1879064342.desc: While stealthed, you may attempt to lighten the pockets of unsuspecting targets.

1879097878.name: Tendon Shred
1879097878.desc: Your teeth bite deeply into your foe, tearing a tendon and opening a chance for a warband manoeuvre.

1879110166.name: Tale of Frost and Flame
1879110166.desc: This aura increases the Fellowship's Frost and Fire Mitigation.

1879112982.name: Sure Aim
1879112982.desc: Your Archer can take additional time to make sure their arrows strike a vulnerable point.

1879115286.name: Eldar Arrowhead
1879115286.desc: These arrow heads are deadly against corrupted enemies.

1879136790.name: Centre
1879136790.desc: You can recover morale and strength in the midst of combat.

1879139734.name: Toxin
1879139734.desc: A ranged attack which flings a draining poison on the target, causing power damage over time.

1879158166.name: The Sky is Falling
1879158166.desc: You cluck shrilly, panicking at the wide open space above you!

1879198358.name: Friend of the Wilds (Mountain-guardian)
1879198358.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879209878.name: Steed of the Rune-keeper
1879209878.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the rune-keeper.

1879231254.name: Behind the Shield
1879231254.desc: A quick throw from behind a shield.

1879232406.name: Ranged Fierce Resolve
1879232406.desc: Drains morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

1879239062.name: Favour of the Mearas
1879239062.desc: You have been granted the knowledge of mending your war-steed during combat. This skill will have no effect on standard steeds.

1879239574.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879239574.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>
The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus toward survival in battle. Skills utilize your mount as a means to avoid direct conflict and to assist you in defending yourself throughout the course of a fight.

1879260054.name: Improved Swift Bow
1879260054.desc: Loose three missiles in rapid succession.

1879260310.name: Burglar's Treat
1879260310.desc: A Burglar is not always about tricks. Sometimes a treat is in order.\n\nThis skill gives you and your allies a temporary buff.

1879266838.name: Blood of the Dúnedain
1879266838.desc: Strength of morale has long been a noted feature of the line of Elros. This will restore morale to the Ranger.

1879351574.name: Noble Eagle Kite
1879351574.desc: Brings out a noble eagle kite for you to fly.

1879365654.name: Lasgalen Spring Steed
1879365654.desc: A steed dressed to celebrate spring.

1879416086.name: Guide to Trestlebridge
1879416086.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Trestlebridge.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879418262.name: Journey to the Hall of Vérnozal
1879418262.desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Vérnozal

1879457558.name: Ranged Unseen Strikes
1879457558.desc: A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.\n\nThis skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

1879485334.name: White Hamster
1879485334.desc: Summons an adorable hamster to keep you company.

1879486486.name: Proud Lioness
1879486486.desc: Summons a proud lioness to accompany you on your travels.

1879488022.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Flame-beak Caller)
1879488022.desc: Summons a raven-type companion.\n\nThe flame-beak caller specializes in buffing and debuffing.
